items.title: Pay gas annual settlement balance
items.quote: Bitte gleichen Sie diese Rechnung binnen 30 Kalendertagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum aus; Teilzahlungen sind nach Absprache möglich.
items.computation: Invoice date 27.11.2026. Under §187(1) BGB the day of the event is not counted, so the period starts 28.11.2026. 30 calendar days end on 27.12.2026 (§188). 27.12.2026 is a Sunday, so under §193 BGB the deadline moves to Monday 28.12.2026. This is not a public holiday in NRW.

warnings: The 30 days run from the invoice date, not from receipt. Without the weekend shift the last day would be Sunday 27.12.2026, so paying by Friday 25.12.2026 is the safe option. That day is a public holiday, so in practice pay by Thursday 24.12.2026.
